brand.name: Afterglow
brand.tagline: One fragrance told in four stages, from the gold of last light to deep violet, and you do not see the bottle until the end.
brand.product: A signature fragrance. One scent, not a range.
brand.character: The hour after sunset. A thing met in sequence, not all at once.
brand.visual-world: Four stages tracing the sky after sundown. The light only ever deepens. The brand is felt in the world, never stamped on it.
brand.reveal-rule: The bottle is shown last. Nothing in the storefront leads with packaging.
brand.launch-fiction: Launch night 17 October 2026, Brooklyn venue, doors 7:00 PM. Press walk through the scent room by room before seeing the bottle.

ground.name: Void
ground.use: Page ground. Required by the deepening-light rule, not borrowed

stages._note: Ramp E, picked 9 October 2026 from brand/2026-10-07-stage-palette-pass-2.html; stage two named from brand/2026-10-09-stage-two-names.html. Lightness falls in even steps of 0.16 in OKLCH and chroma is held flat at 0.110. The stages are NOT required to warm in hue: the brief's "each room runs warmer than the last" is about air temperature for scent diffusion and was scoped event-only on 7 October 2026. The theme has no color_palette or color_scheme in config/ at all, so these become a schema addition during the build rather than values dropped into a slot that is waiting for them.

typography._status: Pairing D, picked 9 October 2026 from brand/2026-10-09-type-specimen-pass-2.html. Both faces are in Shopify's font library, checked against the font table in the theme settings documentation on 9 October 2026, so neither needs a webfont in assets. The theme ships with one font_picker (type_primary_font, default work_sans_n4), so a second picker is a schema addition during the build. The scale is a ratio, not a list: every step is base times ratio to a whole power and brand_audit recomputes it.

scale._note: Sizes are authored in rem in CSS: divide by the 16px root so browser font-size preferences are respected, per WCAG.

spacing._status: Base 8px, every step a whole multiple. 8 divides the 16px type base, so spacing and text sit on one grid rather than two that nearly agree. Authored in rem in CSS, same as type.

radius._status: Near-zero, per the spec. Restraint and a void ground point there and nothing in the source material argues otherwise. `subtle` exists only for a control that would otherwise look cut from paper; it is not a card style.

shadow._status: Absent. On a void ground elevation reads through the surface steps, #141414 recessed and #2B2B2B raised, not through a shadow that has nothing to fall on. `hairline` is the border token drawn as a ring, for the rare case where two surfaces at the same step must be told apart.

motion._status: Personality was locked by the brand; these are the two numbers it was missing. The curve ends at its destination and never passes it, which is what 'deepening, never snapping' means in a timing function. Note this governs interactive states only: the guideline document's ground is a mapping from scroll position, not a transition, so it has no duration at all.
motion.personality: Deepening, never snapping. The scent is met as a journey, not a cloud.
